$comment: The one source of the paid tiers. scripts/stripe-catalogue.mjs makes Stripe match this file and audits it; the tenant control plane reads the same limits. Amounts are in cents; a paid price is per seat (quantity = seats). Tiers approved 2026-09-22; the storage add-on (per 10 GB block, quantity = blocks) proposed the same day. secure_links_per_member is each member's own allowance of live secure links; the secure-links add-on (per 50-link pack, quantity = packs, team and business only, approved 2026-10-17) adds 50 links per pack to ONE pool the whole workspace shares (secure_links_pool). Storage grants cut to 2/5 GB per seat and the storage add-on, relay overage and document-appends prices re-derived from billing/rates.json on 2026-10-18 (docs/plans/billing-automation.md); every DERIVED entry is written by scripts/update-rates.mjs and checked by billing/derive.test.mjs, never edited by hand.

addons.name: Citadel Workspace Extra Storage
addons.$comment: DERIVED (billing/derive.mjs): DO SQLite $0.20/GB-month x 10 GB x the multiplier, rounded up to the addon step; the year is 10 months. The 2026-09-22 price of $2 was 1x cost. billing/derive.test.mjs fails if this drifts from rates.json x pricing-model.json.

metering.$comment: Approved 2026-09-23 (the owner asked for cost passed through plus a margin; docs/plans/tenant-quotas.md). Until the SDK RelayGate exists the metered quantity is every byte a tenant sends INTO its object (bytes_in): each relayed byte arrives once, and control traffic is small beside it. gb_bytes: a billed GB is 10^9 bytes. max_frame_bytes: one WebSocket message larger than this closes the socket (1009), to protect the 128 MB isolate. flush_seconds: how often an object with open sockets writes its counters to its own storage.

metered.$comment: DERIVED (billing/derive.mjs): the dearer relay path (Cloudflare Realtime TURN, $0.05/GB; the tenant object itself relays at <= $0.006/GB) x the multiplier, rounded up to the cent. One price whichever path carried it, since customers do not choose the path. Approved at 10 cents on 2026-09-23 (2x TURN); re-derived 2026-10-18 pending the owner (docs/plans/billing-automation.md decision 5).
metered.name: Citadel Workspace Relay Overage

meter.display_name: Citadel relay GB beyond the plan

metered.$comment: DERIVED (billing/derive.mjs). Proposed 2026-10-18, pending the owner (docs/plans/billing-automation.md decisions 2-4). A document append writes 3 DO rows over its life (update + log head, then the compaction delete) at $1.00/M rows plus 1/20 of a $0.15/M request: $3.01 per million. Per paid seat the plan includes document_appends_per_seat per period; beyond that, whole thousands are billed through a Stripe Billing Meter at this price x the multiplier, rounded up to the cent.
metered.name: Citadel Workspace Document Edits Overage
